description: Abstract class 'GenericMap' implementing a custom map with thread-safe updates, iteration, and utility methods, part of the 'org.apache.ofbiz.base.util.collections' package.

classes.name: GenericMap
classes.description: An abstract, thread-safe implementation of the Map interface with custom iteration and modification tracking.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the map if not empty, updating modification count.

methods.name: containsValue
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in the map.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on entrySet, keySet, and values.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, optimized for GenericMap.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves value for a key, with optional access note.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns a set of map entries, lazily initialized.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns a set of keys, lazily initialized.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns a collection of values, lazily initialized.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the map.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Adds all entries from another map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the map.

methods.name: appendTo
methods.description: Appends string representation to a StringBuilder.
